source: Real production Home Assistant frontend in Chromium, existing phones and public controls.
theme: Existing Home Assistant theme, including its actual transparency and colours.
processing: Rectangular browser screenshot crops and lossless PNG optimization only. No generated, redrawn or injected UI state.
illustrative_video: The gate picture is an existing illustrative camera input carried through a real browser-to-browser call. It is not a private or physical gate-camera capture.
privacy_review: Crops contain only VoIP UI and illustrative video. Private camera views, household avatars, weather, map/geolocation details, credentials and unrelated dashboard content are excluded.

presentation_observations.answered_call: Two existing browser phones, public Casa to Test call and a real pointer click on visible Answer.
presentation_observations.minimize_reopen: Same call ID and browser media client across minimize and reopen; received canvas rendered the illustrative video.
presentation_observations.qualification_scope: Presentation documentation only. No ESP, physical camera, acoustic, trunk or full historical WebSocket EOF qualification.

cleanup.persisted_browser_popup_binding: Original absent binding preserved; authenticated source storage was never saved by the capture contexts.
cleanup.phone_preferences: Existing auto-answer, send-video and DND values preserved.
cleanup.websocket_observation: Four later media WebSocket handles emitted Close. Two earlier caller handles lacked a Close event; document-generation attribution was not collected, so their historical EOF remains unqualified. Browser contexts were disposed; final runtime and process checks independently confirmed quiescence.
